attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the Quarter ended 30th September, 2026 in respect of utilization of proceeds of the Preferential Issue of Equity Shares of company
voiceSummary: DEE Development Engineers Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report from CARE Ratings Limited for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding the utilization of proceeds from a Preferential Issue aggregating Rs. 300.00 crore. The report confirms that all proceeds were utilized in accordance with the offer document objects. Specifically, Rs. 225.00 crore was fully utilized to reduce working capital limits. No deviation from the objects was observed. The monitoring agency noted that three entries aggregating Rs. 0.59 crore were inadvertently debited from the escrow account but were reversed and credited back in October 2026. The report also highlights that the auditor issued a qualified opinion for the subsidiary Malwa Power Private Limited due to losses incurred after the Power Purchase Agreement expiry and tariff reduction.

attchmntText: DEE Development Engineers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 14, 2026.
voiceSummary: Dee Development Engineers Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved the standalone and consolidated results along with the Limited Review Report from auditors S.R. Batliboi & Co. LLP. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 29,298.68 lakhs, and profit after tax was Rs. 2,345.30 lakhs. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 58,744.90 lakhs, and profit after tax was Rs. 3,953.60 lakhs. The auditor noted an inability to determine impairment for assets of Rs. 5,063.34 lakhs in subsidiary Malwa Power Private Limited due to lack of evidence following the expiry of its Power Purchase Agreement. An emphasis of matter highlights litigation regarding tariff revisions. The results are placed on the company website.

attchmntText: DEE Development Engineers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Monthly Business Updates for the month of October 2026
voiceSummary: DEE Development Engineers Limited filed an intimation regarding updates on its monthly execution and order position for the period from 1st October 2026 to 31st October 2026. The total order inflow during October 2026, including amendments and currency fluctuations, was 148.41. The total executed value during the same period was 93.02. The closing order book as of 31st October 2026 stood at 2,586.43. The cumulative order inflow for the financial year 2026-27 as of 31st October 2026 was 1,327.06. The cumulative order executed for the financial year 2026-27 as of 31st October 2026 was 684.54. This information is available on the company website.

attchmntText: DEE Development Engineers Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Dee Development Engineers Limited has announced an earnings conference call scheduled for Tuesday, 17th November, 2026, at 3:00 PM IST. The call will discuss the company's operational and financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY27. Management participants include Chairman and Managing Director Mr. Krishan Lalit Bansal and Chief Financial Officer Mr. Brham Prakash Yadav. Investors and the general public can join via pre-registration at the company website or through dial-in numbers provided by Adfactors PR. The information is also available on www.deepiping.com.
